newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, July 8 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 9 ins. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 9 ins. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Nine vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 2 sbm, 1 wheat, 1 maize, 1 soya, 1 naphtha, 1 by-products. 1 Discharging gasoil. 5 Vessels in roads, 26 due at 6 terminals during this week and next. Forecast indicates that draft will rise about 0.10 metres during next week. Pasa berth draft, 23 ft. 1 in. fw. Rosario - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 discharging fertiliser, 2 loading fruit, 1 loading sun oil, 1 loading millet seed, 1 loading sbo. 9 Vessels in roads, 7 Due within this week and next. Forecast indicates that draft will rise about 0.10 metres during next week.

Villa Constitucion - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading wrc, 1 discharging iron ore. 1 Vessel in roads, 1 due. Elevator berths, max. draft 22 ft. 0 ins. fw. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading steel products. 1 Discharging iron ore. 1 Vessel in roads, 6 due during this week and next. Forecast indicates that draft will rise about 0.15 metres during next week. San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 1 due. San Lorzo, Rosario, San Nicolas, San Pedro - Max. recommended draft 32 ft. 6 ins./33 ft. 0 ins. fw. (high tide). Buenos Aires - 17 Vessels in port, 25 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 6 ins. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud, max. recommended draft 28/29 ft. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel).

Necochea - Five vessels berthed of which 3 loading maize, 2 discharging dap. 18 Vessels in roads, 7 due within the next week. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 discharging dap, 1 loading sunflower pellets, 1 loading malt, 1 discharging barley. 2 Vessels in roads, 19 due within the next week. Drafts vary for individual berths.

BRAZIL - July 8 - Vitoria - Three vessels berthed of which 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 bulk soya loader, 1 steel tubes loader. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders, 1 fuel discharger. Praia Mole - 2 Steel products loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - No vessels. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader. 6 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - 30 Vessels berthed of which 6 full container loader/dischargers, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk chemical products loader/discharger, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 10 sugar loaders, 2 fruit loaders, 1 bulk sulphur loader, 1 general cargo loader, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 general cargo loader/discharger, 1 vehicles loader, 1 iron ore discharger, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 bulk soya loader. 18 Vessels waiting in roads, 93 due over the next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 2 Iron ore dischargers. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Rio Grande - Five vessels berthed of which 2 full container loaders, 1 soy loader, 1 cellulose loader, 1 fertiliser discharger. 1 Vessel waiting in roads, 27 due over the next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 1 paper discharger, 2 container dischargers, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 oil discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 general cargo/steel products loader. Tecon - 2 Vessels, 40 due over the next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 4 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - No vessels, 1 waiting in roads, 6 due over the next 7 days.

Paranagua - 14 Vessels berthed of which 3 fertiliser dischargers, 2 general cargo dischargers, 2 sugar loaders, 2 pellets loaders, 2 soya loaders, 3 general cargo loaders. 24 Vessels waiting in roads of which to load, 8 sugar, 3 pellets, 3 general cargo, 4 soya. To discharge, 3 fertiliser, 3 general cargo. 24 Vessels due over the next 7 days.

CHILE, July 7 - Arica - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 15 Vessels due this week, port working normally. Iquique - Four vessels berthed, 2 berths vacant. 12 Vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 11 Vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Three vessels berthed and operating, 6 berths vacant. 1 Berth (pier 2) out of service until next April. 17 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Four vessels in port operating, 5 berths vacant. 19 Vessels due during the week. Port working normally.

Puerto Montt - Three vessels in port, port working normally. Punta Arenas - Two vessels berthed at terminal, 3 due during the week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, 4 due this week, none waiting in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed and operating, 7 due this week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels berthed, terminal out of service. 3 Vessels due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, none due this week. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, none due this week. Oil terminal - No vessels berthed, none due this week.
Lirquen - Six vessels berthed, 2 due during the week. Port working normally. Penco - No vessels berthed, 1 due during the week.

PERU, July 7 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Three vessels anchored, 6 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing days. Paita - No vessels anchored, 1 fish meal vessel berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels, no delays. Talara - One vessel anchored, 1 oil tanker berthed, no berthing delays. Chimbote - Three vessels anchored, 4 fish meal vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Ilo - One vessel anchored, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, July 7 - Puerto Cabello - Four vessels anchored, 7 berthed of which 5 grain cargo, 2 general cargo. 1 Vessel under repair. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Docks 10 and 26 under repair. Guanta - Three vessels berthed of which 2 grain, 1 bulk cargo. July 8 - All ports working normally. Orinoco river - Draft at 8/7 35 ft. 0 ins. Dredger Guayana anchored at mile 178 and Hang Jun anchored between miles 11 and 6. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels operating of which 1 loading iron pellets, 1 iron ore. 8 Vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel loading iron ore, 1 vessel due. Palua - Two vessels due. Matanzas - Four vessels operating of which 1 loading steel products, 2 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 discharging dolomite. 5 Vessels due. San Felix - One vessel loading aluminium, 1 due. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel loading refined products, 1 due. Venalum - One vessel loading aluminium.

Alcasa - One vessel due. Puerto Cabello - One vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge, 16 operating of which 15 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 discharging sugar. 14 Vessels due, 2 under repair. Venterminales - One vessel due. Bajo Grande - One vessel loading crude oil, 2 due. Guanta - Four vessels operating of which 2 discharging grain, 1 salt, 1 pipes. 3 Vessels due. La Guaira - Three vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 1 passenger vessel, 3 vessels under repair, 2 due. Amuay - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products. Cardon - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 loading refined products. Guaranao - One vessel loading/discharging general cargo. El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea.
